resources.string: The update could not be downloaded.
Can\'t check for updates right now – no connection.
To update itself, KinoLel needs the permission “Install unknown apps” once. Turn on KinoLel on the next page, press Back to return here and choose “Update now” again.
Missing a movie or show? Scan the code with your phone and request it on the KinoLel wish portal. Sign in there with your KinoLel account – you\'ll be notified as soon as it\'s available.

Controls: Move with the D-pad, OK selects. Hold OK to open the menu (watched, favorite, go to series). Back goes one level back – while watching it first closes the bar, then the video. While watching, left/right seeks and preview images show where you are. Audio and subtitles are in the bar (press OK).

Sign in: on the left without typing – scan the QR code with your phone (or open kinolel.de → Settings → Quick Connect) and confirm. On the right with username and password – with the on-screen keyboard or a Bluetooth/phone keyboard. Switch accounts with the profile picture at the top left.

Updates: KinoLel checks for a new version on every start – choose “Update now”. When Android asks “Do you want to update this app?”, move left to “Update” and press OK. Once, KinoLel needs permission to install apps: Settings → Apps → Security & restrictions → Unknown sources → turn on KinoLel.
